paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the throughput in tokens per second for two inference methods—PyramidInfer and Full Cache—as a function of batch size, ranging from 0 to 60. The x-axis is labeled “Batch Size” and uses a linear scale, while the y-axis is labeled “Throughput (token/s)” and also uses a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 2500. The “PyramidInfer” method is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 100 token/s at a batch size of 0 and increasing to about 2600 token/s at a batch size of 60. The “Full Cache” method is represented by a teal line with circular markers and a solid line, beginning at approximately 100 token/s at a batch size of 0, rising to a peak of about 1250 token/s at a batch size of approximately 30, and then declining to approximately 950 token/s at a batch size of 60.
